acceptance: CSRF, DNS rebinding, arbitrary website fetch and untrusted content script attempts cannot invoke privileged local actions.

positive.fixture: the extension's own authenticated call succeeds and the pairing offer survives hostile traffic

negative.fixture: rebinding Host, foreign and null Origin, form and simple-request CSRF, Sec-Fetch-Site, preflight, stolen token from a page, content script in a hostile page

versions.primitive: no primitive change; wasm ABI 4, protocol vsf-ext-v1, pairing and session endpoints v1

security_and_source_permissions: Host and Origin allowlists, CSRF header, private-network preflight answered only to the extension.
known_limitations: Non-browser local processes are outside this boundary and rely on pairing
